cover_headline: PepsiCo to Cut About 1,000 North America Jobs in Restructuring
facts: PepsiCo is eliminating about 1,000 jobs across its North American food and beverage operations over the coming week
North American beverage volumes fell 2% last quarter, and food volumes were flat
Management cut its full-year core EPS growth outlook to 1% to 2%

end.headline: PepsiCo to Cut About 1,000 North America Jobs in Restructuring
end.line: North America CEO Ram Krishnan told staff the changes, due within a week, will simplify a structure he called complex and fragmented, after beverage volumes fell 2% last quarter.

quote.text: Too much of how we work today remains complex and fragmented.
quote.speaker: Ram Krishnan
